summary:
The 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour connects two of central Greece’s major historical sites in a compact overnight journey from Athens. Visit Delphi and the Sanctuary of Apollo before continuing north toward Meteora, where centuries-old monasteries stand on immense natural rock formations. With only two days available, the itinerary prioritizes the essential visits while covering a considerable distance between the two regions.
The overnight stay breaks up the journey and makes it possible to experience both sites without returning to Athens in between. Operating year-round, the tour includes selected 4-star accommodation with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees, transfers and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Athens to Delphi
itinerary.text: Leave for Delphi via Thebes, Levadia and the picturesque village of Arachova, on the slopes of Mount Parnassus, arrive in Delphi and visit the Archaeological Site. After the visit depart for Kalambaka, passing through picturesque villages and towns of Central Greece. Dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Tour the Meteora Monasteries and Athens
itinerary.text: Visit Meteora and enjoy a unique and most impressive scenery with ageless Monasteries, containing priceless historical and religious treasures, standing between earth and sky atop huge rocks. Return to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, Thermopylae (short stop to see across the road the Leonida’s Monument), arrive in Athens early in the evening.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour?
faqs.a: The 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour covers Delphi, Meteora, and Kalambaka. You will visit the ancient Sanctuary of Apollo at Delphi and explore the spectacular monasteries of Meteora, one of Greece's most famous UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The tour runs for 1 night and 2 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €395 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, transportation between destinations, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions included in the tour?
faqs.a: The tour includes the archaeological site of Delphi, the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Delphi Archaeological Museum, the breathtaking Meteora monasteries, and the charming town of Kalambaka located beneath Meteora's towering rock formations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 1 night at a carefully selected hotel in the Kalambaka area with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient location near Meteora.

faqs.q: Does the 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers interested in Greece's ancient history, religious heritage, and natural beauty. It offers a perfect short introduction to two of the country's most important cultural and historical destinations.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and climbing stairs at some Meteora monasteries. Uneven surfaces and moderate walking are involved, but most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Delphi and Meteora?
faqs.a: Delphi was once regarded as the center of the ancient Greek world and is famous for the Oracle of Apollo. Meteora is renowned for its extraordinary monasteries perched atop dramatic rock formations, offering some of the most spectacular scenery and spiritual heritage in Greece.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 2-Day Delphi & Meteora Monasteries Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, combine the tour with Athens, or extend your trip to other destinations in Greece. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
